Definition: of Hebrew origin (H1036); Bethleem (i.e. Beth-lechem), a place in Palestine:--Bethlehem.
BiblicalUsage: The name Bethlehem appears in the New Testament. It turns up in Matthew 2:1, Luke 2:4 and John 7:42.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Bethlehem is worth knowing, because God's people actually walked there.
